purpose: Prospective five-dataset extension bringing the controlled-basis screen from 25 to 30 distinct datasets.
selection_timing: Selected after the 25-dataset Phase 1 screen and before loading labels or running any extension model.
selection_rule: Use five additional locally available RTDL-format datasets, absent from the original 25, covering binary classification, multiclass classification, regression, numerical-only and mixed tables. Exclude learning-to-rank tasks, duplicate copies of existing benchmark datasets, feature width above 500, and output cardinality above 100.
